kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نقتطف (form VIII)
# نَقْتَطِفُ (naqtaṭifu) /naq.ta.tˤi.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# نُقْتَطَفُ (nuqtaṭafu) /nuq.ta.tˤa.fu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# نَقْتَطِفَ (naqtaṭifa) /naq.ta.tˤi.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# نُقْتَطَفَ (nuqtaṭafa) /nuq.ta.tˤa.f
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
